bagPolicy.summary: Only small bags up to A4 size, 12 × 8 × 3 inches, are permitted for concerts. Backpacks and rucksacks are prohibited even when small.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Concert parking is first come, first served once sales open but must be booked before show day; it cannot be purchased on arrival.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The club’s concert guide and travel page do not designate a concert rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Hot and cold food, including vegan and halal options, is available inside and outside. Fans may bring one empty plastic refillable bottle up to 750 ml; metal bottles are prohibited.
allowed: Empty plastic bottle up to 750 ml
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible concert tickets are offered through the official event ticketing channel. The club’s concert page sets age limits by standing or seated location.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Concert tickets at the Etihad Stadium are valid for one admission only, and pass-outs are not permitted, so once you leave you cannot come back in.

ticketPickup.summary: All general admission and accessible concert tickets are sold through Ticketmaster, so manage and access your tickets there.

gates.summary: Bring the concert ticket and identification for age checks; small bags are inspected at security. Show-specific entry times are provided with the event.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
